title: thea caudata
intro: Thea caudata, commonly known as Yunnan tea or Yunnan gold tea, is a type of Camellia sinensis varietal native to Yunnan province in China. It is a subspecies of the Camellia sinensis plant, which is also the source of other types of tea. Thea caudata is known for its rich flavor and potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as theaflavins and thearubigins, which have been reported to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, and may also have therapeutic actions in reducing stress and improving cognitive function.
